cards.def: the way a child is cared for and taught how to behave
cards.ex: A stable upbringing shapes a child's character.
cards.exVn: Sự nuôi dạy ổn định định hình tính cách của trẻ.

cards.def: a family consisting of parents and children only
cards.ex: The nuclear family has replaced the extended family in cities.
cards.exVn: Gia đình hạt nhân đã thay thế gia đình nhiều thế hệ ở thành phố.

cards.def: a family including grandparents, aunts, uncles, etc.
cards.ex: In Vietnam, extended families often live under one roof.
cards.exVn: Ở Việt Nam, gia đình nhiều thế hệ thường sống chung một mái nhà.

cards.def: a brother or sister
cards.ex: Sibling rivalry is a normal part of growing up.
cards.exVn: Ganh đua giữa anh chị em là phần bình thường của quá trình lớn lên.

cards.def: a family in which one parent raises the children alone
cards.ex: Single-parent families face particular financial pressures.
cards.exVn: Gia đình đơn thân đối mặt với áp lực tài chính riêng.
coll: grow up in a single-parent family

cards.def: the activity of raising a child
cards.ex: Good parenting requires both love and discipline.
cards.exVn: Nuôi dạy con tốt cần cả tình yêu lẫn kỷ luật.

cards.def: demanding that rules are obeyed
cards.ex: Strict parents may raise obedient but anxious children.
cards.exVn: Cha mẹ nghiêm khắc có thể nuôi con biết nghe lời nhưng hay lo âu.

cards.def: not strict when punishing or controlling
cards.ex: Overly lenient parenting can lead to spoiled children.
cards.exVn: Nuôi dạy quá dễ dãi có thể tạo ra những đứa trẻ hư.

cards.def: to give a child everything they want so they behave badly
cards.ex: Grandparents tend to spoil their grandchildren.
cards.exVn: Ông bà thường nuông chiều cháu.

cards.def: a strong connection between people
cards.ex: Shared meals strengthen family bonds.
cards.exVn: Bữa cơm chung củng cố mối gắn kết gia đình.

cards.def: all the people born at about the same time
cards.ex: Each generation faces its own unique challenges.
cards.exVn: Mỗi thế hệ đối mặt với những thách thức riêng.

cards.def: the period between childhood and adulthood
cards.ex: Adolescence is a time of rapid emotional change.
cards.exVn: Tuổi vị thành niên là giai đoạn thay đổi cảm xúc nhanh chóng.

cards.def: unwilling to obey rules or accept authority
cards.ex: Teenagers often go through a rebellious phase.
cards.exVn: Thanh thiếu niên thường trải qua giai đoạn nổi loạn.

cards.def: a person that others admire and copy
cards.ex: Parents are children's first and most important role models.
cards.exVn: Cha mẹ là hình mẫu đầu tiên và quan trọng nhất của trẻ.

cards.def: time spent giving full attention to somebody you care about
cards.ex: Busy parents struggle to spend quality time with their kids.
cards.exVn: Cha mẹ bận rộn khó dành thời gian chất lượng cho con.

cards.def: the legal ending of a marriage
cards.ex: Divorce rates have risen in most developed countries.
cards.exVn: Tỷ lệ ly hôn đã tăng ở hầu hết các nước phát triển.

cards.def: the legal right to take care of a child
cards.ex: The court granted the mother custody of the children.
cards.exVn: Tòa án trao quyền nuôi con cho người mẹ.

cards.def: the person who earns the money to support a family
cards.ex: Men are no longer always the sole breadwinner.
cards.exVn: Đàn ông không còn luôn là trụ cột kinh tế duy nhất.

cards.def: regular jobs done at home such as cleaning and cooking
cards.ex: Couples should share household chores equally.
cards.exVn: Vợ chồng nên chia sẻ việc nhà công bằng.

cards.def: respect and care for one's parents, valued in Asian cultures
cards.ex: Filial piety remains a core value in Vietnamese families.
cards.exVn: Lòng hiếu thảo vẫn là giá trị cốt lõi trong gia đình Việt.

cards.def: to take care of somebody or something
cards.ex: Many adults look after both children and elderly parents.
cards.exVn: Nhiều người lớn phải chăm sóc cả con cái lẫn cha mẹ già.

cards.def: to care for a child until they are an adult
cards.ex: She brought up three children on her own.
cards.exVn: Bà ấy một mình nuôi dạy ba đứa con.

cards.def: to gradually become less close to somebody
cards.ex: Friends often grow apart after leaving school.
cards.exVn: Bạn bè thường dần xa cách sau khi rời trường.

cards.def: to have a friendly relationship with somebody
cards.ex: Not all teenagers get along with their parents.
cards.exVn: Không phải thanh thiếu niên nào cũng hòa hợp với cha mẹ.

cards.def: respect felt by two people for each other
cards.ex: Healthy relationships are built on mutual respect.
cards.exVn: Các mối quan hệ lành mạnh được xây dựng trên sự tôn trọng lẫn nhau.

cards.def: a person of the same age or status as you
cards.ex: Children learn social skills from their peers.
cards.exVn: Trẻ học kỹ năng xã hội từ bạn đồng trang lứa.

cards.def: the ability to understand another person's feelings
cards.ex: Reading fiction helps children develop empathy.
cards.exVn: Đọc truyện giúp trẻ phát triển sự thấu cảm.

cards.def: the pleasant feeling of being with somebody
cards.ex: Pets provide companionship for elderly people living alone.
cards.exVn: Thú cưng mang lại sự bầu bạn cho người già sống một mình.

cards.def: the state of being alone or separated from others
cards.ex: Social isolation is a growing problem among the elderly.
cards.exVn: Cô lập xã hội là vấn đề ngày càng lớn ở người già.

cards.def: to care for and help somebody or something develop
cards.ex: Parents should nurture their children's natural talents.
cards.exVn: Cha mẹ nên nuôi dưỡng tài năng tự nhiên của con.

cards.def: to gradually make somebody feel or believe something
cards.ex: Parents try to instil good values in their children.
cards.exVn: Cha mẹ cố gắng khắc sâu các giá trị tốt đẹp vào con cái.

cards.def: to teach a child to obey rules and control their behaviour
cards.ex: Experts disagree about how best to discipline children.
cards.exVn: Các chuyên gia bất đồng về cách rèn kỷ luật trẻ tốt nhất.

cards.def: protecting somebody too much so they cannot become independent
cards.ex: Overprotective parents may hinder a child's independence.
cards.exVn: Cha mẹ bao bọc quá mức có thể cản trở sự tự lập của trẻ.

cards.def: able to do things yourself without depending on others
cards.ex: Chores teach children to be self-reliant.
cards.exVn: Làm việc nhà dạy trẻ tính tự lập.

cards.def: to look or behave like an older family member
cards.ex: She takes after her mother in both looks and temperament.
cards.exVn: Cô ấy giống mẹ cả về ngoại hình lẫn tính cách.

cards.def: a person in your family who lived a long time ago
cards.ex: Vietnamese families honour their ancestors at home altars.
cards.exVn: Gia đình Việt thờ cúng tổ tiên tại bàn thờ trong nhà.

cards.def: the legal relationship between two people who are married
cards.ex: People are delaying marriage until their thirties.
cards.exVn: Mọi người đang trì hoãn hôn nhân đến độ tuổi ba mươi.

cards.def: to live together as a couple without being married
cards.ex: More couples choose to cohabit before marrying.
cards.exVn: Ngày càng nhiều cặp đôi chọn sống chung trước khi cưới.

cards.def: a person who depends on somebody else for money or care
cards.ex: Workers with dependants need stable incomes.
cards.exVn: Người lao động có người phụ thuộc cần thu nhập ổn định.

cards.def: a strong feeling of love or connection
cards.ex: Early attachment to caregivers shapes emotional development.
cards.exVn: Sự gắn bó sớm với người chăm sóc định hình phát triển cảm xúc.
